posts.text: Malicious Ad Campaign Used iPhone Exploits to Hunt Wallet Seed Phrases A malvertising operation spent roughly six months turning ordinary online ads into a delivery system for iOS exploits, and crypto wallets were the prize. Confiant researchers, who call the campaign MoldyRoost, published their findings on Nov 20. The operation ran from May 12 to Nov 17, 2026 and was tied to more than 480 ad domains split across six clusters of activity. One cluster did most of the work: 403 domains, aimed mainly at Hong Kong, Japan and Singapore. The wider reach covered iPhones in 47 countries.
